piece.headline: ARORA ROARS BACK, KHAMANKAR CLINGS ON
piece.standfirst: Rajat Arora posts the best score in the league and cuts the gap at the top to 3. Khamankar's armband flopped again.
piece.big_picture: Aryan Khamankar is still top, but the lead has shrunk to 3 points. Rajat Arora's João Pedro armband did the damage. Cherag sits a further 3 back, so the top 3 are packed tight.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Tanish named his XI and the bench scored 37. The real match was happening where he wasn't looking. Go gently on a tough week, but that lineup got away from him.
piece.one_to_watch: Khamankar leads Rajat Arora by 3 in the title race. If Arora's armband keeps landing and Khamankar's keeps misfiring, the top spot could change hands next week.

winners.name: Rajat Arora
winners.verdict: Skipped Haaland for João Pedro and got 24 from the armband. That's nerve, and it paid. The best score in the league, no argument.

winners.name: Utkarsh
winners.verdict: Palmer captain, 16 from the armband, and a jump into the Big prizes. Solid, sensible and rewarded. Quietly one of the week's smartest.

winners.name: Cherag
winners.verdict: Backed Palmer and collected 16 from the armband. Nothing flash, just a big week that keeps him third and right in the title race.

losers.name: Zishan
losers.verdict: Played the Free Hit and fell 50 places. A chip that was meant to rescue the week ended up sinking it. Brutal.

losers.name: Tanish
losers.verdict: Paid for transfers, backed Fernandes with the armband, and watched the bench score 37. Luck had a hand, the lineup helped it along.

losers.name: Aryan Apte
losers.verdict: Dropped 27 places. The bench held 16 points that would have softened it.

ratings.l: Went against the crowd and the crowd got a lesson. Best score in the league.
